purpose: Test whether the remaining V24 physical-tail failure is caused by training a target-density-reweighted denoiser while sampling and evaluating the unreweighted conditional data distribution.

findings: TNG100 and SIMBA failures are distributed across 23 and 12 ensemble fields rather than one corrupt member.
Generated G21 upper-support occupancy is lower than truth in all three domains.
No one of the 35 replayed failed fields has terminal centered latent z at or above 5; ordinary fields do, so support clipping is not necessary for failure.
The 208 replayed fields reproduce the frozen ensembles within 5.960464477539063e-08 y, exactly one-half float32 machine epsilon.
On three frozen audited batches the target-tail gradient is 1.60-2.12 times the unweighted gradient norm and has cosine -0.36 to -0.06 against it.
The target-dependent weighted denoising objective is not a proper score objective for the unreweighted conditional distribution used by the sampler and gate.

single_change.description: Change only the EDM denoising objective from 0.5*unweighted+0.5*target-density-tail-weighted to 1.0*unweighted proper score matching.
single_change.tail_weight_fit_role: retain frozen weights in provenance and diagnostics only; they must not enter the optimized loss, gradients, validation selection, or checkpoint choice

scientific_rationale.proper_objective: For Gaussian corruption, uniform EDM denoising estimates the score of the original conditional latent distribution. Multiplying voxel errors by a function of the clean target changes the conditional optimum and therefore trains a reweighted distribution that the unchanged probability-flow sampler is not intended to generate.
scientific_rationale.why_not_clip_or_change_sampler: The exact replay establishes that failed fields do not require terminal support overflow and that global terminal maxima correlate only 0.003 with TNG physical maxima and 0.157 with SIMBA physical maxima.
scientific_rationale.why_not_more_capacity_or_steps: V24 plateaued from step 25000 to 30000 and moderate capacity scaling improved Q4 but did not remove the multi-field Q3 maximum failure.
scientific_rationale.why_not_rectified_flow: The frozen V6 fair comparison already found flow comparable at the field gate but rejected it at every paired grid-HOP abundance interval, so repeating it without a new mechanism is not justified.
scientific_rationale.historical_unweighted_note: V8 used a different Laplacian residual, two-domain representation, base-32 model, 10000-step horizon, and no V14 multiscale standardization, V21 conditional Gaussianization, or prior-matched initialization; it is not a controlled test of this single V25 change.
